transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I want to thank you all for joining this discussion. As Director of Operations, I'm responsible for deciding whether Casey continues as sponsor of the process-improvement initiative, and if so, under what conditions. I know that several of you have experienced tension during this initiative related to feedback, and I take that seriously. Before I make any decision, I need to walk through my standard governance checklist with all of you. That includes reviewing stakeholder observations of any repair efforts, confirming agreed contact boundaries, checking active commitments, and making sure we're following applicable workplace-relations procedures. The governance file captures all of these elements, and I want to make sure we're aligned on what's recorded there. I'd like to start by hearing from each of you: what have you observed, and what concerns do you want on the record?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Thank you, Elena. I appreciate the structured approach and the opportunity to be transparent. I want to be upfront: this week I told the project coordinator that I'm willing to accept a coaching plan lasting exactly 45 days and to attend every scheduled session. I want to make sure that's formally captured in the governance file so it's on the record for you. I take the tensions that have been raised seriously, and I'm committed to participating constructively in any repair process. I'd welcome hearing from the other stakeholders about what they've observed so I can understand their concerns fully and respond appropriately.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Elena, I want to put something on the record that I haven't formally logged yet. I personally observed exactly three occasions where Casey repaired harm — each time by apologizing, correcting a public misunderstanding, and inviting the affected teammate to revise the next agenda. I haven't entered these examples into the formal feedback system, but I think they're relevant to your review of observed repair efforts and should be part of the governance file.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Elena, I need to put something on the record that I haven't raised directly with you yet. I need all contact with Casey regarding the initiative to be facilitated rather than unmoderated one-to-one contact for exactly the next 30 days. After that 30-day period, I'd also need a separate preparation meeting before any joint discussion takes place. I want this captured as a contact boundary in the governance file so it's formally part of your review.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Elena, before you finalize any decision to retain Casey as sponsor, I need to flag something critical from the current workplace-relations procedure that hasn't yet been added to the initiative's governance packet. If Casey is retained as sponsor in the context of a substantiated interpersonal concern, the procedure requires two specific things: an independent HR check conducted exactly on day 30, and a written no-retaliation notice issued to the affected parties. These requirements are not yet recorded in the governance file, and I want to make sure they're formally captured before any sponsor decision is made.
